item.title: Military Standard on Software Control Levels
item.description:

item.title: Heart and Kidney Diseases and Type 2 Diabetes May Be One Ailment
item.description:
📝 The good news, says Ndumele, who led the heart association group that developed the CKM framework, is that CKM can be treated with new drugs. Heart disease causes 40 to 50 percent of all deaths in people with advanced chronic kidney disease. At present, around 59 million adults worldwide have diabetes, about 64 million are diagnosed with heart failure, and approximately 700 million live with chronic kidney disease.
